versions.content: Support of Container Pdus Type: valid Description: The System Template shall support the definition of Container Pdus. Dependencies: – Use Case: Routing of Pdus from a network onto a network with higher payload possibility (e.g. CAN onto CanFD or Ethernet). Supporting Material: –
